1.web: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

2.web: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
2.asv: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

3.web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
3.asv: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

4.web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
4.asv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

5.web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
5.asv: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.

6.web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
6.asv: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

7.web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
7.asv: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.

8.web: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
8.asv: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.

9.web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
9.asv: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.

10.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
10.asv: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that dohis commandments: His praise endureth for ever.
